description: Hopper FullFlow inputs. Unit suffixes are authoritative; pressures are absolute (psia) unless a difference (psi) or gauge (psig). Paths are relative to this file. Null tube OD/wall means unmeasured; ID is then required. Tag values with a "note" on the component, or in the notes section by JSON path: "EDIT" = expected to change, "GUESS" = nobody has confirmed it. Notes feed the component table and the parameter workbook.

not_modelled.OQD: LOX fill quick disconnect below OFD (disconnected in flight)

Initial COPV pressure.note: EDIT +-2 % (user); one draw, the bottles are filled together

notes.simulation.maximum_step_s: 0.05 s gives the same engine results as 0.01 s in ~40 % of the time; the bang-bang is sampled less often, so tank pressure overshoots ~10 psi more. Use 0.01 to study the tank band.
notes.pressurization.copv_model: lumped: all bottles as one volume (user, needs identical bottles). header: each bottle feeding a common header (Vedanth, 2026-11-05), for bottles that differ; stiff, so it needs maximum_step_s near 0.005
notes.pressurization.header_volume_l: GUESS used only by copv_model header; placeholder (Vedanth, 2026-11-05), needs measured plumbing
notes.pressurization.controller_period_s: Bang-bang sampled once per time step, as a flight computer sampling its transducer
notes.engine.mixture_ratio: EDIT target O/F (user, 2026-10-30; was 1.8 from vehicle_sim)
notes.sequence.main_valve_start_s: GUESS OTV + FTV start opening (vehicle_sim.py started at full flow at t = 0)
notes.sequence.step_smoothing_s: Shortest OTV/FTV move between profile points
notes.sequence.throttle_rate_limit_lbf_s: EDIT thrust slew limit (GNC fluid-network slides: 180 lbf/s sim, 90 lbf/s MC). null = step in step_smoothing_s (vehicle_sim-like)
notes.sequence.ramp_breakpoint_spacing_s: Solver steps no longer than this through the opening / closing ramps
notes.outputs.keep_run_history: false keeps only the latest raw history (Outputs/Hopper_Prop_System.h5, ~220 MB); true also keeps one in every run archive
notes.vent.time_requirements_s: Sheet OVNT target vent time, sheet FVNT vent time
notes.lox_drain.extra_elements: EDIT ground side of the drain (OQD, GSE line) once known
notes.lox_drain.outlet_drop_in: EDIT GUESS drain exit below the tank bottom
notes.lox_drain.ullage_pressures_psig: EDIT GUESS test pressures; 0 = vented, gravity only
notes.lox_drain.tank_height_in: LOX total length (tank dimensions table); cross-section = tank volume / height
notes.tank_sweep.valve_margin_fraction: EDIT design limit: valve at most this fraction of full open
notes.torch.enabled: Off by default: the torch fires ~0.2 s and barely changes the burn
notes.torch.open_time_s: EDIT GUESS OIMV + FIMV open (main valves start at sequence.main_valve_start_s)
notes.torch.valve_stroke_s: EDIT GUESS OIMV / FIMV opening and closing time
